alg076.gaussian: CN(0,I_N), E|X_j|^2=1, real and imaginary variance 1/2
alg076.measurement: input-independent complex linear L_omega with independent seed omega and complex rank r_omega<=k<N
alg076.decoder: arbitrary measurable g(omega,L_omega x), all randomness in independent omega; no original-input access or uncounted side information
alg076.rank_necessity: liminf k_N/N>=1-epsilon^2 for fixed 0<epsilon<1 and uniform success bounded away from zero for Lebesgue-almost-every input
alg076.evaluator_cost_scope: Only the retained ordinary dyadic evaluator: (RK/2)log2(K)+(N/2)log2(M) executed butterflies and charged full scans; no general circuit lower bound.

fiveprime.model: R binary square; D[r,c]=R[r,c]*zeta_(5q)^(r*c) with primitive zeta; both complete Grams dI (either square identity implies both)
fiveprime.q7_control: 7-by-35 rectangular row block, degree11, row Gram11 I7; not a square equality mask
